# Galar

[Back to the guide](../players-guide.md#part-2-walkthrough-and-strategy)

Galar has 39 Explore areas and a ladder of 8 gyms, 4 Elite Four seats and a champion. Its areas come from Sword and Shield (both versions).

How to read the tables: **Chance** is the share of that area's encounters, once the whole story is open. **Level** is what you meet. A Pokemon marked *later in the story* shows up only after more badges.

#### Gym 4: Bea (Stowonside) -- the Fighting Badge
Fighting specialist. 4 Pokemon, best level 36: your team fights at level 36 at most, and on hard you bring 4 at most. Prize money: $1,800 on easy, $3,600 on hard (half again for a rematch).

| Machamp | Fighting | 36 | Drain Punch, Double-Edge, Low Sweep, Strength |

**Hit them with** Fairy, Flying, Psychic moves. **Their attacks are** Normal, Fighting, Ground, Flying, Dark. **Careful with** Rock, Steel Pokemon: several of those attacks hit them hard. **Tested team:** Togekiss, Noivern, Gallade, Gardevoir, Roserade, Orbeetle. Chosen by simulated battles from the Pokemon you can catch in Galar by this point, raised to level 36 and evolved by level where they can; with IVs around 20 and training 75 it won **100%** of battles on easy and **100%** on hard (bringing the first 4).

### The Pokemon League

The four Elite Four seats and the champion are one run: HP comes back for every fight, PP does not, and you cannot put your Pokemon to bed until it ends. See [the League](../players-guide.md#9-gyms-and-the-pokemon-league).

#### Elite Four, seat 1: Marnie
Dark specialist. 5 Pokemon, best level 49: your team fights at level 49 at most, and on hard you bring 5 at most. Prize money: $2,450 on easy, $4,900 on hard (half again for a rematch).

| Pokemon | Type | Level | Moves |
|---|---|---|---|
| Liepard | Dark | 47 | Scratch, Fury Swipes, Nasty Plot, Dark Pulse |
| Toxicroak | Poison/Fighting | 47 | Close Combat, Poison Jab, Earth Power, Rock Smash |
| Scrafty | Dark/Fighting | 47 | Hi Jump Kick, Crunch, Feint Attack, Scary Face |
| Morpeko | Electric/Dark | 48 | Bite, Spark, Thundershock, Bullet Seed |
| Grimmsnarl | Dark/Fairy | 49 | Play Rough, Dark Pulse, Spirit Break, Bite |

**Hit them with** Fairy, Ground, Fighting moves. **Their attacks are** Normal, Electric, Grass, Fighting, Poison, Ground, Dark, Fairy. **Careful with** Rock, Water, Dark Pokemon: several of those attacks hit them hard. **Tested team:** Hippowdon, Gardevoir, Durant, Mr. Mime, Golisopod, Ninetales. Chosen by simulated battles from the Pokemon you can catch in Galar by this point, raised to level 49 and evolved by level where they can; with IVs around 20 and training 75 it won **100%** of battles on easy and **100%** on hard (bringing the first 5).
